stem: Which statement describes a behavior of light in the microscope?

options.label: A
options.text: Light travels through the microscope lens without changing direction.

options.label: B
options.text: Moving in straight lines causes light to increase in brightness.

options.label: C
options.text: Light refracts through the lens of the microscope.

options.label: D
options.text: Moving in straight lines keeps light from reflecting.

visual_elements: photo of a girl observing a microscope
